messages.subject: Longitudinal SEM: Latent Growth and CLPM in R
parts:
Hello LAVAAN members

Explore advanced methods for analyzing change over time in your research with this comprehensive seminar. Longitudinal SEM in R: Latent Growth and Cross-Lagged Panel Models led by Michael Zyphur (University of Queensland and Instats) is now available as an on-demand streaming seminar. This seminar equips researchers with the skills to implement advanced latent growth modeling (LGM) and cross-lagged panel modeling (CLPM) techniques using lavaan in R, enabling them to analyze complex longitudinal data. By mastering these lavaan techniques, researchers can rigorously investigate how variables change over time and influence each other, enhancing the depth and validity of their longitudinal studies. Working with real data, attendees will gain hands-on experience that can be directly applied to their own datasets, strengthening their analytical capabilities and informing more robust theoretical conclusions.

Access this seminar at your own pace and please share this with colleagues and students who might benefit!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Professor and Director
